notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that can add {U} and that shares a name with at least two other lands you control.
description:
Play the land.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, adding at least two additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
